editorial: When you think a high school love story can't get any sweeter, this romantic comedy defies expectations. It turns a group of haughty girls into a heartwarming quartet through a tutor who speaks less than he acts, and the result feels fresher than a campus reunion. The standout element is an original soundtrack that morphs emotional beats into sing‑along moments, making each twist feel both familiar and new. Even so, the final ten minutes can feel a bit rushed, trimming some of the gentle banter that has built so much chemistry. You will enjoy it most if you love breezy romance, slice‑of‑life anime, and glowing character arcs that finish with a promise.
targetAudience: Ideal for those who enjoy quirky love stories and slice‑of‑life anime.
